headline: JetBlue Creditors Hire Restructuring Advisers as Debt and Shares Sink
summary: Senior creditors to JetBlue have hired financial adviser PJT Partners and law firm Akin as the airline's shares and bonds continue to decline.
why: Distressed debt restructuring advisers are brought in when companies face solvency pressures, signaling elevated default risk for bondholders.

impacts.name: JetBlue Airways
impacts.why: Creditor mobilization points to severe liquidity constraints and potential balance sheet restructuring.

why_moved: Deteriorating bond and share prices forced creditors to organize and retain restructuring counsel to protect their recovery values.
